# Merino Protect

> Premium sustainable merino wool clothing and accessories for men, featuring temperature-regulating base layers, outdoor apparel, and everyday essentials.

Merino Protect specializes in high-quality Australian merino wool products certified by Woolmark and major sustainability standards. Their collections emphasize natural odor resistance, moisture management, and temperature regulation for active lifestyles.

## Key Topics

- Australian Merino Wool
- Woolmark Certified
- Temperature Regulation
- Odor Resistance
- Base Layers
- Sustainable Fashion
- Merino-X-Pure
- Merino-X-Blend
- Responsible Wool Standard
- Outdoor Apparel
- Thermal Wear
- Moisture Management
- UPF 50+ Protection
- WRAP Certified
- ISO 9001
